residual_risks: The handler accepts x_astro_path as a route override whenever x-vercel-isr is 1, including on the _render function. Whether an external client can cause this condition depends on Vercel's handling of the header and rewrite query parameters, which cannot be verified from this checkout. If clients can supply both, path-based platform protections or ISR exclusions could be bypassed.
testing_gaps: The existing path-override security tests do not exercise an untrusted x-vercel-isr header together with x_astro_path; a deployed Vercel test is needed to establish whether that combination reaches the handler.
